justification: Both depict a large-headed anthropomorphic being whose head carries an elaborate ornamented covering rendered with fine incised hatching, and both build the composition vertically with blocky, simplified limbs. But A is a fully three-dimensional stack of crouching creature-like bodies with a beast-like upturned face, while B is a flat single standing frontal figure in low relief surrounded by ornamental/possibly sign-like fields, so the specific subject, pose and relationships differ substantially.
